title: Student Assistant in Architecture & Technology
description:
Are you studying IT, software engineering, computer science, or a related field and looking for a student position where you can work with enterprise architecture, documentation, and modern technology? At Nordic RCC, you will join a team helping build the digital foundations that support the Nordic power system and the green transition.

If you are looking to make an impact in supporting the green transition of the energy sector across Finland, Norway, Sweden and Denmark, you might be the person we are looking for.

Join a fast-developing Nordic company and become a part of an agile environment where we develop innovative solutions. Nordic RCC is an important contributor to the green energy transition, supporting the Nordic transmission system operators in ensuring efficient and secure operations of the Nordic electricity power system.

Your role

As a student assistant in Architecture & Technology, you will be part of a dynamic team that includes architects across multiple domains. In this role, you will support the Architecture & Technology team in documenting our architecture landscape and develop guidelines and standards for architecture documentation. You will work closely with Enterprise, System and Application Architects and gain first-hand experience of how architecture is used to guide technology decisions across a growing organisation.

What you will do

  • Assist the architecture team in ensuring the quality of existing documentation

  • Create architecture models according to standards and guidelines, and support in architecture modelling and documentation activities

  • Assist in implementation governance tools

  • Contribute to governance activities, including architecture reviews and assessments

  • Research emerging technologies, trends, and industry best practices

  • Prepare presentations, reports, and decision material for management and stakeholders

We’re looking for someone with

  • Relevant Background: You are currently pursuing a bachelor’s or master’s degree in Computer Science, Software/IT Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field

  • Collaborative Attitude: You enjoy working with others and are comfortable interacting with both technical and non-technical stakeholders

  • Interest in Architecture & Technology: You are curious about how organisations design, govern, and evolve their technology landscape

  • Structured Working Style: You have an eye for detail and enjoy creating order, structure, and clarity in documentation and information

  • Analytical and Curious Mindset: You have a strong curiosity for technology, and enjoy analysing complex topics, identifying patterns, and creating structure and clarity from information

  • Proactive Approach: You take initiative, ask questions, and are not afraid to explore new topics independently while seeking guidance when needed

Through this role, you will gain practical experience with enterprise, system, and application architecture, on-premises technologies, and technology strategy. You will have the opportunity to work alongside experienced architects and technology professionals while contributing to initiatives that support Nordic RCC's mission and the green energy transition.

The role is designed to provide meaningful hands-on experience, allowing you to apply your academic knowledge in a real-world environment while developing both your technical and professional skills.

The position will require approximately 10-15 hours per week, depending on your study workload. We are flexible during exam periods and expect that you have at least 1½ - 2 years left of your studies.

You will join a diverse organization of 25 nationalities, where inclusivity is celebrated, with more than 30% women on board (and a commitment to improving this balance). We are located in Copenhagen Towers office in Ørestad, with the flexibility to balance on-site and remote work 2 days a week.

At Nordic RCC, we live by the values of fellowship, curiosity, respect, and transparency—values defined by our employees that shape how we collaborate and innovate. If you see yourself thriving in such an environment, we’d love to hear from you.

title: Management Support Role to Service Operations - At the Heart of the Nordic Power System
description:
Are you motivated by supporting highly skilled engineers and contributing to the secure operation of the Nordic power system? Do you thrive in an environment where operational reliability, collaboration, and continuous improvement are essential?

At the Nordic Regional Coordination Centre, in the Service Operations department, you will work closely with a team of engineers delivering critical services to the Nordic Transmission System Operators around the clock. In the role, you will act as a daily sparring partner and facilitator for the engineering team, helping ensure effective coordination between control center duties and development activities outside the operator chair.

This role offers a unique opportunity to contribute to the security of supply and the Nordic green energy transition, while supporting the development of engineers working in a highly specialized operational environment.

Nordic RCC – supporting security of supply and the green energy transition

Nordic Regional Coordination Centre (RCC) provides critical services and insights to support the national Transmission System Operators (TSOs) in Finland, Norway, Sweden and Denmark — to ensure the efficient operation and use of the Nordic power system and high security of power supply at any time.

Based in Copenhagen, Nordic RCC is one of six RCCs in Europe, equally owned by the Nordic region's four electricity TSOs: Fingrid, Statnett, Svenska Kraftnät, and Energinet.

As European power systems integrate and evolve to meet climate goals, Nordic RCC provides regional coordination, integrated services, regional insights and recommendations to the Nordic TSOs and their control centres, to support cross-border operational security 24/7.

Join Nordic RCC, a fast-developing company determined to make a significant impact in the energy sector and to provide for a secure and efficient transition to the green, sustainable energy system.

Right now, we are looking for a management support role who would like to make a difference!

Job description:

You would be supporting an engineering team that works in a hybrid setup, combining:

  • Operator-on-shift roles in the Nordic RCC coordination centre, supporting Nordic TSOs around the clock

  • Work outside the operational shift including projects, operational follow-up, and continuous improvement activities

Your primary focus will be daily coordination, professional sparring, and supporting the development of effective structures and ways of working across the team, supporting and facilitating the performance of these roles.

You will NOT be part of the Operator on-shift roster, who is performing the coordination centre tasks and services 24/7.

The position does not initially include formal personnel management, as the engineers in the setup today report directly to the Head of Department in Service Operations. You will work closely with the Head of Department on topics like department structure and set-up, and by providing day-to-day coordination and operational support, as well as mentoring and sparring on subject matter topics with the team.

Responsibilities:

  • Driving department strategy and development in collaboration with the Head of Department (HoD) supporting effective coordination between coordination centre duties and non-operational activities, both within the team and externally towards other departments

  • Facilitating knowledge sharing, supporting and securing continuous training and collaboration

  • Supporting engineers in their professional development, and acting as a sparring partner, particularly those early in their careers

  • Identifying opportunities to improve structures, processes, and operational workflows

  • Supporting planning, prioritization, and follow-up across shifts, projects, and operational tasks

  • Contributing to continuous improvement of service quality and operational efficiency as well as securing the level of contingency and business continuity

  • The role will include sharing of responsibilities as part of 3rd line support with Head of Department as the department runs 24/7 operational services

Requirements:

You bring experience from a technical or operational environment and enjoy supporting the development and collaboration of highly skilled professionals.

We expect that you:

  • Have experience working in a technical, operational, or knowledge-intensive organization

  • Demonstrate strong ability to mentor, support, and collaborate with technical specialists

  • Have experience identifying and improving structures, processes, and ways of working

  • Are comfortable working in a complex environment with the responsibility of 24/7 operational services

  • Communicate clearly and effectively across technical and organizational boundaries

Additional beneficial competencies include:

  • Experience from the power system, electrical infrastructure, or energy sector

  • Engineering or technical background

  • Experience working in control centre or operational environments

  • Familiarity with organizations delivering 24/7operational services

We encourage you to apply even if you do not meet all the listed requirements.

What we offer

You will be joining a company of competent, diverse, and enthusiastic colleagues. We are currently 25 nationalities with over 30% women (striving to improve this balance) and all ages.

Your daily workplace will be in our newly furnished office premises in Copenhagen Towers, Ørestad. We offer workplace flexibility to ensure a healthy work-life balance, including the possibility to work from home some of the time. 

Our values of fellowship, curiosity, respect, and transparency have been defined by all employees. They identify how we behave and shape the way we work together, and we expect you to see yourself in them.

The position is conditioned upon a satisfactory background check as well as a national security clearance, both of which will be facilitated by Nordic RCC. You can read more on security clearance here. Please also note, that the process includes that any spouse, registered partner, cohabitant, steady partner, co-resident, child over 18 living at home and parent with the same address as the candidate must also consent to be examined.

Application deadline and contact information

Please apply online as soon as possible (in English) and no later than September 13th  2026. We may conduct interviews on a continuous basis.

A cover letter is not required, but we kindly ask you to include a few sentences in your CV explaining why you are interested in the position. Applications are only accepted through our online recruitment system.

To ensure a fair and unbiased recruitment process, we kindly request that you do not include a photograph in your CV or any other materials.

title: Køkken souschef søges til Muban Thai Roskilde
description:
KØKKEN SOUSCHEF SØGES TIL THAIRESTAURANT

Vi søger en dygtig og engageret køkken souschef, som har lyst til at blive en vigtig del af den daglige drift i vores thairestaurant.

Du bliver en central person i køkkenet og arbejder tæt sammen med køkkenchefen og resten af teamet. Vi leder efter dig, der har passion for det thailandske køkken, tager ansvar og kan bevare overblikket, når tempoet er højt.

Om restauranten

Vi er en thairestaurant med fokus på autentiske smage, gode råvarer og retter tilberedt med respekt for det traditionelle thailandske køkken.

I køkkenet arbejder vi blandt andet med wokretter, curries, nudler, risretter og forskellige klassiske thailandske specialiteter. For os er kvalitet, smag og konsistens afgørende, og vi lægger stor vægt på, at gæsterne får den samme gode oplevelse hver gang.

Restauranten tilbyder både servering i restauranten og takeaway, og derfor kræver hverdagen et køkken, hvor samarbejde, planlægning og effektivitet går hånd i hånd.

Dine primære ansvarsområder

Som køkken souschef vil du blandt andet:

  • Støtte køkkenchefen i den daglige ledelse og koordinering af køkkenet

  • Tage ansvar for køkkendriften, når køkkenchefen ikke er til stede

  • Koordinere arbejdsopgaver og sikre et effektivt flow under travl service

  • Sikre, at retterne lever op til restaurantens krav til smag, kvalitet og præsentation

  • Deltage aktivt i tilberedning, produktion og mise en place

  • Planlægge prep og fordele arbejdsopgaver blandt køkkenpersonalet

  • Introducere, oplære og støtte nye medarbejdere

  • Bidrage til et godt samarbejde og en positiv arbejdskultur i køkkenet

  • Kontrollere varemodtagelse, lagerbeholdning og korrekt opbevaring af råvarer

  • Arbejde aktivt med at begrænse madspild og sikre et fornuftigt vareforbrug

  • Overholde og følge gældende regler for hygiejne, egenkontrol og fødevaresikkerhed

  • Bidrage med idéer til udvikling og forbedring af retter og menuer

  • Hjælpe med at sikre en stabil og velfungerende køkkendrift – også når der er ekstra travlt

Vi søger dig, der

  • Har relevant erfaring fra et professionelt køkken

  • Gerne har erfaring med thailandsk eller anden asiatisk gastronomi

  • Har interesse for eller erfaring med at lede og koordinere et køkkenteam

  • Kan arbejde selvstændigt og samtidig fungerer godt som en del af et hold

  • Er struktureret, stabil og ansvarsbevidst

  • Kan bevare roen og prioritere opgaver i travle perioder

  • Har fokus på kvalitet og ensartethed i køkkenet

  • Gerne har kendskab til woktilberedning, curries og traditionelle thailandske smage

  • Har forståelse for køkkenhygiejne og fødevaresikkerhed

  • Er fleksibel i forhold til arbejdstider og arbejdsopgaver

  • Kan kommunikere på engelsk. Kendskab til thai er en fordel, men ikke et krav.

Vi tilbyder

  • En fast fuldtidsstilling på 37 timer om ugen

  • En vigtig rolle med ansvar og mulighed for indflydelse

  • Et arbejdsmiljø med fokus på samarbejde, kvalitet og god energi

  • Mulighed for at arbejde professionelt med thailandsk gastronomi

  • Mulighed for både faglig og personlig udvikling

  • Varierende arbejdsdage og ansvar i den daglige køkkendrift

  • Fleksibel planlægning af vagter

  • Løn efter erfaring og kvalifikationer

Vi søger en souschef, som ikke er bange for at tage fat, og som gerne vil være med til at udvikle både køkkenet og teamet.

ENGLISH

KITCHEN SOUS CHEF WANTED FOR THAI RESTAURANT

We are looking for a skilled and motivated Kitchen Sous Chef to become an important part of the daily operation of our Thai restaurant.

As Sous Chef, you will work closely with the Head Chef and the rest of the kitchen team. We are looking for someone who is passionate about Thai cuisine, takes responsibility and is able to stay organised and focused in a fast-paced kitchen environment.

About the restaurant

  • Understands food hygiene and food safety requirements

  • Is flexible regarding working hours and responsibilities

  • Can communicate in English. Knowledge of Thai is an advantage but is not required.

We offer

  • A permanent full-time position of 37 hours per week

title: Assistant Professor Position in Naval Architecture and Marine Engineering
description:
SDU Mechanical Engineering (SDU ME) invites applications for an Assistant Professor in Naval Architecture and Marine Engineering. SDU ME is part of the Institute of Mechanical and Electrical Engineering (IME) at the Faculty of Engineering, University of Southern Denmark, located at the main campus in Odense. The position is available from January 1, 2027, with the specific start date to be agreed upon with the successful candidate.

 

The position and research environment 

You will join the maritime group at Mechanical Engineering, where the main research topics are seakeeping, data-driven maintenance, and energy systems and efficiency. The group works within applied research, carried out in close collaboration with industry and other research groups. The group is part of the larger Maritime Center at SDU, offering strong opportunities for transdisciplinary and cross-faculty collaboration. In addition, the center is actively developing strong relationships with external partners. The candidate is expected to play an active role in this community, contributing both to research and administrative activities within the center. This includes outreach to other universities, industry, maritime educational institutes, authorities, and professional organizations to establish and strengthen collaborative relationships.

Furthermore, SDU conducts defense-related research. The successful candidate is therefore expected to have an interest in dual-use research within the relevant research fields, and to actively engage in outreach to other universities as well as the Danish Defence.

To complement our team, we are looking for candidates within naval architecture and marine engineering / mechanical engineering, with documented research experience in one of the following fields:

  • Data-driven operation of ships – Energy efficiency and predictive maintenance, digital twins, and the use of machine learning and sensor data to optimize vessel operation and efficiency.

  • Seakeeping and comfort onboard vessels - ship motion analysis, ship stability, vibration and noise reduction, or human comfort and habitability at sea.

You will bring competence and dedication to teaching and student supervision in mechanical engineering at SDU ME, actively contributing to our two educational programs: Bachelor of Engineering (diplomingeniør) and Bachelor's and Master of Science (civilingeniør). Our engineering programs combine theory courses with project work, and you will be involved in both. 

 

Workplace

SDU ME is part of the Institute of Mechanical and Electrical Engineering (IME) at the Faculty of Engineering, University of Southern Denmark, located at the main campus in Odense. The research activities at SDU ME span widely from fluid mechanics, multi-physics simulation and optimization to condition monitoring and structural dynamics, composite materials, mechanical design, and naval architecture and marine engineering. IME is a multidisciplinary department covering also high-frequency electronics, microelectronics, batteries and super-capacitors, additive manufacturing, smart structures and energy technologies. The department is an exciting environment, where you will be exposed to many different fields and have your general academic curiosity stimulated.

The position is full-time and located at the SDU main campus in Odense. Given the research, teaching, and collaborative nature of the position, you are expected to be present on campus on a regular basis and to relocate to Denmark, if currently residing abroad.

SDU Odense is the university’s largest campus and provides a strong framework for interdisciplinary research, teaching, and innovation. You will be part of a modern workplace with high professionalism, strong academic communities, and a commitment to diversity and equal opportunities. SDU also offers dedicated support for International Staff. Learn more about careers and work life at SDU here: Careers at SDU.

 

What we expect 

You must have:

  • Completed a PhD degree in a relevant discipline

  • The ability to teach basic mechanical engineering curricula

  • Communication skills in English at an adequate level for research communication and teaching

It is preferred that you also have experience from/with:

  • Postdoctoral research positions

  • Co-supervision of PhD students

  • Teaching and course development

  • Funding applications

  • Collaboration with industrial partners

You are expected to apply for own grants and to contribute to joint applications with the group and its collaborators. Strong potential to compete for national and international research funding is essential.

During the period of employment as Assistant Professor, you are expected to develop an independent research profile; publish high-quality research outputs; contribute to attracting external research funding; develop documented teaching and supervision competences, including completion of the Lecturer Training Programme; and contribute actively to collaboration, knowledge exchange, and the academic environment at SDU Mechanical Engineering.

 

Further information 

For more information about the position, contact Head of Section Associate Professor Dorte Smedegaard Schmidt (phone +45 65507432, e-mail dss@sdu.dk) or Professor Marie Lützen (phone +45 65509625, e-mail mlut@sdu.dk).

For more information about SDU ME, please see https://www.sdu.dk/da/mechanical.

For more information about IME, please see https://www.sdu.dk/en/ime. 

Further information for international applicants about entering and working in Denmark. You may also visit WorkinDenmark for additional information.

Further information about The Faculty of Engineering.

If you experience technical problems, please contact our email support.

 

Application

Applicants are advised to read the SDU information on how to apply.

Assessment of candidates is based on the application material, and the application must include: 

  • Motivated application (up to 2 pages). 

  • Complete Curriculum Vitae (up to 4 pages).

  • Master’s and PhD degree certificates or equivalent (original and an official English translation).  

  • Complete list of publications. 

  • Up to 10 publications most relevant to the position. 

  • Teaching Portfolio documenting teaching, learning, and supervision qualifications and approach. Any format is acceptable; see the Faculty's teaching portfolio page for inspiration.

  • A proposed research plan (up to 4 pages).

  • References/reference letters may be included.

  • A statement/documentation of other qualifications relevant to the position may also be included. 

All documents must be in English and PDF format. CPR number (civil registration number) must be crossed out. All PDF-files must be unlocked, allow binding and may not be password protected. 

SUBMISSION GUIDE: Motivated application must be uploaded under ‘Cover letter’ (max. 5 MB), Curriculum Vitae must be uploaded under ‘Resume’ (max 5 MB). All other documents must be uploaded under ‘Miscellaneous documents’ (max 10 files with a maximum 50 MB per file). 

 

The application deadline is November 1, 2026, at 11:59 PM/23:59 (CET/CEST) 

 

Assessment and selection process

Applications will be assessed by an assessment committee. Shortlisting may be applied, and only shortlisted candidates will receive a written assessment. Read about shortlisting at SDU.  Interviews and tests may be part of the overall evaluation. Read about the Assessment and selection process.  

 

Employment terms

Appointment as an assistant professor is temporary and for an initial 3-year period.

Employment as an assistant professor requires academic qualifications at a minimum of PhD level at the time of employment. Employment will be in accordance with the collective agreement between the Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations for academics in the state including the associated circular on the protocol for the job structure for academic staff at Danish universities and the provisions for assistant professor as described therein. 

Salary is determined in accordance with the applicable collective agreement and based on objective and gender-neutral criteria, including the content of the position, responsibilities, and qualification requirements. As an applicant, you are entitled to information about the starting salary and salary range for the position. This information will be provided during the recruitment process. SDU does not collect information on applicants’ previous salary. Further information on salary and taxation. 

Persons employed in the position may, based on a specific individual managerial assessment, be exempted from time registration, also known as a “self-organizer”.

-

The University of Southern Denmark wishes its staff to reflect the surrounding community and therefore encourages everyone, regardless of personal background, to apply for the position. SDU conducts research in critical technologies, which, due to the risk of unwanted knowledge transfer, is subject to a number of security measures. Therefore, based on information from open sources, background checks may be conducted on candidates for the position(s).

title: Electrical Technician; Location: DK - Esbjerg
description:
Are you passionate about hands-on electrical work in the offshore and maritime industry? Do you thrive on a diverse range of tasks and enjoy travelling as part of your job? If so, this exciting opportunity could be perfect for you!

Your Position
In our Rig & Marine division, we are seeking an Electrical Technician who takes pride in quality craftsmanship and in getting the job done safely. This role offers numerous intriguing challenges, including yard stays and modification projects that contribute to the green transition within drilling rigs and special vessels. Depending on your experience, you may also act as Working Supervisor /
Foreman on selected projects, leading a small team of electricians and cable pullers.

At Semco Maritime safety is a core value, and in this role, you will contribute to maintaining and promoting a strong safety culture while delivering innovative solutions. Above all, your work will make a real change for the global energy sector.

You will join a team of 5 colleagues working both locally and globally on projects within our division. The Rig & Marine division is comprised of 450 colleagues worldwide. This full-time position is based at our headquarters in Esbjerg, Denmark. You should expect between 100-150 travel days per year, with occasional work at our yard or locally in Esbjerg.

“I'm looking for an Electrical Technician who takes pride in the craft. This job is hands-on – pulling cables, terminating, testing and troubleshooting on rigs and special vessels around the world – always with safety first. If you enjoy varied work and being part of a tight-knit team – and perhaps have the ambition to step up as Working Supervisor on our projects – we'd love to hear from you.” - Manager, Electrical Engineering, Frederik Vester Pedersen

Your tasks and responsibilities
You will carry out electrical installation and maintenance work on our projects and report progress to your Supervisor or Project Manager. Quality, safety, and good order in tools and materials are essential in this role.
  • Perform electrical installation work such as cable pulling, glanding, termination, and mounting of equipment according to drawings and specifications.
  • Carry out testing, troubleshooting, and commissioning support on electrical systems on drilling rigs and special vessels.
  • Work in accordance with the permit-to-work system and all HSE rules and regulations, contributing to a strong safety culture on site.
  • Register your hours daily and help keep track of materials, tools, and equipment.
  • Cooperate with colleagues and other contractors on site and report progress and any deviations to your Supervisor.
  • When acting as Working Supervisor / Foreman: lead and coordinate the workforce on site, ensure quality and adherence to deadlines, and approve daily timesheets before handover to the Project Manager.

Your qualifications and Skills
We imagine that you are very independent and thrive when things change rapidly – sometimes by the hour. You are passionate about what you do, and you are eager to get things done in the right way while collaborating with various stakeholders.

To succeed in this position, we expect that you have:
  • A background as an electrician, with a minimum of 5 years of experience in the offshore or marine industry is preferred.
  • Experience reading and working from electrical drawings and technical documentation.
  • Proficiency in English, both oral and written, is essential.
  • Experience with fibre optic splicing is an additional advantage.
  • Experience as a Working Supervisor or Foreman – or the ambition to take on that responsibility – is a strong advantage.

We conduct interviews on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to submit your application promptly via the link provided on the page.
For any inquiries, please feel free to contact Manager, Electrical Engineering, Frederik Vester Pedersen, +45 7916 6420 
We are excited to hear from you and potentially welcome you to our team!

Welcome to Semco Maritime 
At Semco Maritime, we create change. For people. For projects. And for the global energy sector. With us, you will join a community of over 2,300 of the most dedicated thinkers and doers in the energy industry who are driving real change and making their own personal mark on the global energy landscape. 

While everyone knows why the energy transition is vital, we are concerned with the journey. How to get there. By providing the answers needed to make change real. Because we believe that global energy ambitions can only be realized through hard work and clever pragmatic solutions. This is what we do. This is what we invite you to participate in. 

Safety is at the core of everything we do, and we are committed to protecting our people, partners, and the planet as we work towards a sustainable energy future. 

So yes, working for us will change the energy sector – and may well change you too.  

We know that our people are our greatest strength. We strive to build an inclusive workplace where everyone can be themselves, contribute their perspectives, and feel part of the team. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and believe that diverse teams help us find better solutions and move the energy transition forward.   

Care to join the movement?

description:
Are you searching for a place to work where you can truly make a difference and have a leading role in our continued expansion? A role where you will have the trust as well as the responsibilities to play a key role in shaping the way we work? Within a team that is the pillar for all developmental work within our division, driving innovation and setting the standard for all upcoming projects? Then this is your chance to not just show what you’re made of, but also to join a world leader within renewables energy that have no intention to slow down the green energy transition.

Your position
We offer you an interesting and challenging job in an international organization, where we strive to provide innovative and creative solutions. You will get the unique opportunity to work in an environment characterized by dedication, passion, and ambition.

At Semco Maritime you will be joining our dedicated Product Line Team in our Renewables Division whose mission is to develop solutions for Offshore Substations engineered and constructed together with our close partners. Our goal is to standardize solutions while maintaining flexibility to align client needs with supplier capabilities. Offshore substation industrialisation is the key enabler for the green transition worldwide, and as such, your product solutions will need to reflect that. We have the largest project portfolio within offshore substations worldwide, so you will join a well-established company in growth and work with a team of changers.

“We are world-leading within offshore substations, and we have a strong focus on both AC and DC connections, as well as advanced floating technologies. Our Offshore Wind markets include Europe, Asia, and the USA, which means that you can expect to be involved in projects worldwide!” - Director, Product Line Management, Jannick Elmbæk Olsen.

Your tasks & responsibilities
As our new Electrical Engineer for High Voltage, you will be responsible for development, implementation, and maintenance of the products and solutions offerings for our offshore substation product line.

Your tasks will include but are not limited to:
  • HV/MV product and solutions development and maintenance in line with future market requirements
  • Proposal development based on the architecture framework and the client’s requirements
  • Working closely with our Tender team focusing on our customers Employer Requirements and Semco Maritimes own modular architecture
  • Maintain knowledge on market demand and implement product improvements and requirements for product line to fit future projects
  • Coordinate and secure strategic supply chain together with Procurement, including cost-out activities
  • Develop and maintain the product roadmap with input on new technologies from the supply chain, organization, and the market
  • Provide supervision and guidance to the development and execution teams

The successful candidate will be expected to form strong working relationships with the other existing teams e.g., in sales, tender, project management, construction, and most importantly, our in-house engineering organisation.

Your profile & qualifications
You are an experienced HV professional with a product development mindset, preferably coming from either an OEM or from an engineering organisation. Your collaborative spirit and commercial acumen will thrive in our international setting. In addition, you are a proactive team player with a continuous improvement mindset, analytical prowess, and a solution-oriented approach.

To succeed in this position, we expect that you:
  • Have experience with design, procurement and construction of the high voltage and medium voltage systems, such as electrical distribution, power transformers and GIS switchgear.
  • Are familiar with industrial layout design, routing, 3D modelling, structural and weight estimation of high voltage components, preferably on Offshore Substations
  • Have experience with interface management across systems
  • Possess excellent communication skills in English

As a person you are a natural team player and collaborator who enjoy working across many business areas. You have a strong drive and desire to continually develop high quality solutions in a dynamic environment. Furthermore, you have strong analytical and problem-solving skills to come up with efficient ways to solve obstacles.

You are born curious and have a positive mindset.

The position is full time and your work location can be either at our office in Copenhagen, Esbjerg or Gdynia. You should expect up to 10-30 travel days annually.

If you have any questions, you are welcome to contact Head of Solution Engineering, PLM – Jesper S. Rytke +45 2721 9705.
We conduct our interviews on an ongoing basis, so if you are interested, you must submit your application as soon as possible via the link on the page.

Welcome to Semco Maritime 
At Semco Maritime, we create change. For people. For projects. And for the global energy sector. With us, you will join a community of over 2,300 of the most dedicated thinkers and doers in the energy industry who are driving real change and making their own personal mark on the global energy landscape. 

While everyone knows why the energy transition is vital, we are concerned with the journey. How to get there. By providing the answers needed to make change real. Because we believe that global energy ambitions can only be realized through hard work and clever pragmatic solutions. This is what we do. This is what we invite you to participate in. 

Safety is at the core of everything we do, and we are committed to protecting our people, partners, and the planet as we work towards a sustainable energy future. 

So yes, working for us will change the energy sector – and may well change you too.  
We know that our people are our greatest strength. We strive to build an inclusive workplace where everyone can be themselves, contribute their perspectives, and feel part of the team. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and believe that diverse teams help us find better solutions and move the energy transition forward.   

Care to join the movement? 
Change. With us. 
Apply
Share in your network

Semco Maritime is an international engineering and contracting company with 2,300 employees and 40 years of dedication rooted in both the conventional energy sector and the offshore wind industry. This puts us in a unique position to bridge today's and tomorrow’s solutions, constantly seeking clever and pragmatic ways to realise global energy ambitions. We do this through comprehensive project management across all phases of energy projects together with world-leading partners across the globe.

title: Start Your International Career as a Gourmet Butcher – Earn a Salary Throughout Your Apprenticeship - Greater Copenhagen, Denmark
description:
Are you a young EU citizen dreaming of a career in food craftsmanship?

This apprenticeship is open to EU citizens who have the right to live and work in Denmark.

At Born & Kolstrup in Rødovre, Denmark, you will receive a paid apprenticeship, an internationally recognised vocational qualification, and the opportunity to become part of one of Denmark's strongest butcher teams. We are proud winners of the Danish Butcher Award 2025 and are looking for a motivated apprentice who wants to develop in a profession built on quality, craftsmanship and teamwork – in a workplace with an informal management style, employee involvement and excellent opportunities for personal and professional development.

Read more about the award:
https://goderaavarer.dk/aktuelt/nyheder/2025/se-hvem-der-vandt-slagterprisen-2025/
What does a Gourmet Butcher do?
A Danish Gourmet Butcher does not slaughter animals. Instead, the profession focuses on preparing, cutting and refining high-quality meat products and delicacies.
During your apprenticeship, you will learn to:
  • Cut and prepare premium meat products.
  • Produce charcuterie, delicacies, convenience foods and ready meals.
  • Develop new recipes and food products.
  • Work with food safety and quality control.
  • Plan production and work closely with experienced colleagues.

After completing your apprenticeship, you will receive a Danish Journeyman's Certificate, a respected vocational qualification recognised both in Denmark and internationally.
What can you expect from your apprenticeship?
We offer:
  • A paid apprenticeship throughout your education.
  • A thorough introduction and structured training programme.
  • Assistance with finding accommodation, obtaining a CPR number and settling into life in Denmark.
  • A safe workplace with a strong focus on employee well-being.
  • Friendly and experienced colleagues who will support you from day one.
  • An informal working environment with employee involvement.
  • Excellent opportunities for professional and personal development.
  • A healthy work-life balance with time for friends and leisure activities.

Several of our employees have worked abroad themselves and understand what it is like to start a new life in another country.
We are looking for someone who:
  • Is an EU citizen with the right to live and work in Denmark.
  • Has a passion for food, quality and craftsmanship.
  • Is ambitious and eager to become highly skilled.
  • Has completed compulsory education or an equivalent qualification.
  • Can communicate in English.
  • Is willing to learn Danish and become part of Danish culture.
  • Enjoys teamwork and takes responsibility.

Salary and employment conditions
The apprenticeship lasts 3½ years, and you will receive a salary throughout the entire programme.
Monthly salary (collective agreement between DSM and the Danish Food Workers' Union, NNF):
Apprenticeship Year Salary (DKK) Approx. EUR
1st year per month 13.708 1.835
2nd year per month 17.343 2.321
Remaining apprenticeship per month 20.490 2.743
Adult apprentice per month 26.839 3.593
  • Working hours: 160.33 hours per month
  • Employer-paid pension contribution of 12.6% after three months of employment.
  • Salary is paid in Danish Kroner (DKK).

Your education
Your practical training will take place at Born & Kolstrup, located in Rødovre Centrum, just 8 km from Copenhagen City Hall Square.
The school-based training will take place at ZBC in Roskilde, Denmark's largest vocational college.
Ready to take the next step?
Would you like to build an international career with an award-winning company and become a skilled food craftsman in Denmark?

Born & Kolstrup
info@mmm-rc.dk
Learn more about us:
https://mmm-rc.dk/

@bornogkolstrup

No smoking.

title: Postdoc in clinical Raman spectroscopy and AI-based diagnostics
description:
A position as Postdoc (full-time) is vacant at the TE Andersen Lab part of the Research Unit of Clinical Microbiology, the Department of Clinical Research, Faculty of Health Sciences, University of Southern Denmark. 

The position is limited to 3 years with the possibility of extension. 

Shape the future of clinical diagnostics

We are seeking an ambitious and highly motivated postdoctoral researcher to help establish next-generation Raman spectroscopy technologies for clinical microbiology. This position offers a unique opportunity to work at the interface between optics, artificial intelligence, microbiology and clinical diagnostics in close collaboration with hospitals, industry and international research partners.

Research environment

The successful candidate will join the research group led by Professor Thomas Emil Andersen. The group conducts translational research in microbiology, advanced infection models, spectroscopy and medical technology. We collaborate extensively with Danish and international hospitals, universities and industrial partners, with a strong focus on translating innovative technologies into improved patient care.

The academic position

The job involves research, professional development, research education, research-based teaching, and supervision.

Your responsibilities will consist of the following:

  • Lead OUH contributions to the EU- and state-funded projects (Innovation Fund Denmark project nanoRaman, two Eurostars projects MbCare and QMIC, and the MedTech Odense project UriNix).

  • Design, plan and execute experimental studies from concept to publication.

  • Develop Raman spectroscopy workflows for analysis of clinical samples.

  • Apply machine learning and AI for spectral analysis and diagnostic classification.

  • Coordinate collaborations across hospitals, academia and industrial partners.

  • Build and develop a Raman spectroscopy research platform within the Andersen Lab.

  • Supervise students and junior researchers.

  • Publishing results in leading international journals and contributing to future grant applications.

Expectations and qualifications

We are looking for candidates holding a PhD in physics, engineering, optics, spectroscopy, biomedical engineering or a related discipline. The candidate may also hold a PhD within health sciences, biology, microbiology or similar but should then also hold significant knowledge and experience within optical sciences, spectroscopy and related data handling.

Essential qualifications:

  • Significant knowledge and experience with Raman spectroscopy.

  • Experience with optical instrumentation.

  • Experience with machine learning and/or AI.

  • Experience analysing biological or clinical samples.

  • Profound in scientific writing and a solid publication record.

Desirable qualifications:

  • Experience with clinical microbiology or hospital diagnostics.

  • Experience in academia–industry collaborations.

  • Project coordination skills.

  • Ability to work independently while thriving in multidisciplinary teams.

What we offer

  • A unique translational research environment combining engineering and medicine.

  • Participation in major externally funded collaborative projects.

  • Close interaction with clinicians, engineers and industrial partners.

  • Access to state-of-the-art spectroscopy and microbiology facilities.

  • Excellent opportunities for scientific publishing, networking and career development.

Research strategy for OUH and the Department of Clinical Research

The joint research strategy for the Department of Clinical Research and Odense University Hospital sets the direction for our shared research efforts in the years ahead. Rooted in the vision - We conduct research together to shape the patient care of the future - it focuses in particular on: cross-disciplinary research - with people at the centre; strong research environments - as drivers of development; and the research journey - from idea to impact. Further information on the joint research strategy of the Department of Clinical Research and Odense University Hospital is available here.

Further information

Further information about the position can be obtained from Professor Thomas Emil Andersen, e-mail: thandersen@health.sdu.dk, phone: +45 21261634 or Head of Department of Clinical Research, Rikke Leth-Larsen, e-mail: rllarsen@health.sdu.dk, phone: +45 65503477.

Application deadline

August 18, 2026, at 23.59 hrs. (CET).

Salary and terms of employment

The applicant will be employed in accordance with the agreement between the Ministry of Finance and AC (the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations).

The position as Postdoc is placed within salary steps 4–8 of the Danish state salary scale, depending on seniority. In addition, a centrally agreed postdoc allowance is paid, and further qualification- and function-related allowances may be negotiated.

The work location will be at the laboratory of Professor Andersen at the Department of Clinical Microbiology, Odense University Hospital, J. B. Winsløws Vej 21.1, Odense C, Denmark. The laboratory and department will move to the newly built University Hospital associated with the University of Southern Denmark, in late summer 2027.  

Application

Applications must be submitted electronically using the link “Apply now” - see below.

We strongly recommend that you read How to apply for a position at SDU before you apply.

Only applications written in English will be accepted for evaluation.

The application must include (as PDF files) (please note that the application (the motivation letter) and CV must not exceed 10 MB in total):

  • a motivation letter

  • a detailed CV

  • degree certificates (inclusive of Ph.D.-diploma)

  • a complete and numbered list of publications

  • 3 scientific peer-reviewed publications considered by the candidate as most important for this position. Please note that a copy of each publication must be attached as a pdf file.

    • It is permitted to merge copies of the selected publications into a single PDF file.

  • a teaching portfolio detailing the candidate’s prior teaching experience, teaching skills, and teaching philosophy

  • a research plan detailing the candidate’s ideas and plans for her/his future research work

  • An explanation other qualification relevant to the post

For technical issues, please contact: hcm-support@sdu.dk

Please note that all the above-mentioned information must be included in the application.  

Applications received after the deadline and/or incomplete applications will not be considered.

Assessment

Shortlisting will be used as part of the initial selection process. 

Assessment of shortlisted applications will be done under the existing Appointment Order for universities. Shortlisted applications will be assessed by an assessment committee. The committee may request additional information, and, if so, it is the responsibility of the applicant to provide the necessary material. 

When the assessment committee has submitted its report, the applicants will receive part of the evaluation that concerns themselves. 

References will be obtained for the preferred candidate from their current and previous employers. Applicants invited for interview should expect to complete a work-related personality assessment.

Living and working in Denmark

Foreign applicants will be offered Danish language training as part of the employment. 

The International Staff Office (ISO) at SDU provides a variety of services for new employees, guests and people who consider applying for a job at the University of Southern Denmark. 

The University wishes our staff to reflect the diversity of society and thus welcomes applications from all qualified candidates regardless of personal background.

title: Waitress
description:
About Us

Tandoori Twist is an offering from Tinyhus Cafe, a child-friendly cafe in Copenhagen, Denmark, serving authentic Indian delicacies. 

We serve not only classic favourites like butter chicken and biriyani, but also lesser known Indian regional food, with myriad of spices and flavours as our specilities.

Our cafe Tinyhus serves continental food, also traditional local cuisines for events and catering. 

We strive to provide authentic food and exceptional service to our guests and we look for team members who are self-motivated, proactive and passionate to walk the extra mile to provide exceptional culinery experience for our guests. 


Our people, just like our food, are the ambassadors of our cafe and restaurant. If you like challenges and you are looking for a place where you can contribute positively, overcoming the odds of a new but growing restaurant, then please do get in touch; we will look forward to hear from you.

Job Description

Are you a proactive person who enjoys interacting with people, understands their preferences and needs and provides service with a smile? Do you have experience in making coffee and simple cocktails?

Tandoori Twist, a newly established but growing Indian Take-away and Restaurant located in Copenhagen, looking for team member who is outgoing and hard-working. If you have experience as a waiter / waitress and bartender, especially in Asian / Indian restaurant and are proactive, quick-learner, have a pleasant and outgoing personality and can take ownership of tasks, then please feel free to contact us.

Only applications through our career site will be considered https://www.tandooritwist.dk/tandooritwist-career/.


Job description

Your task will be to welcome our guests when they visit the restaurant. You will handle the orders, guide the guests if they need any recommendation, serve food, prepare and serve drinks, take payments, clean the tables and handle take-away deliveries prepared in the kitchen. You will have to make basic cocktails and coffee and serve.

In addition, there is cleaning of our premises and facilities on an ongoing basis and during the opening and closing hours.

This is a part-time position. The work is mainly in the evening and also during weekends. Please note that you need to have right to work in Denmark as work-permit will not be sponsored for this position.


Requirements

Your profile:

• You have a high level of fluency in English (Understanding Danish is an advantage but not mandatory)

• You have a pleasant, outgoing personality and you care for polished and professional appearance

• You remain calm under pressure

• You are truly passionate about high level of customer service, energetic, smiling and attentive

• You truly enjoy customer interaction and have experience in customer-facing sales activity

• Prior experience as a waitress / waiter in a restaurant is mandatory

• Prior hands-on experience either as a Barista and / or as a Bartender is preferred

• You are proficient in making basic cocktails

• Experience in making different types of coffee is desirable; however, if you do not have experience in handling manual coffee machine, you are eager to learn within a short time

• You are a proactive person who takes responsibility and hands-on ownership of the tasks and flexible when it comes to responsibilities and tasks typical for a small but growing organisation

title: Declaration of interest regarding PhD project: The Molecular Endocrinology Department (KMEB), Department of Clinical Research, University of Southern Denmark (SDU), invites applications for a 3-year PhD scholarship
description:
Declaration of interest regarding PhD project:

The Molecular Endocrinology Department (KMEB), Department of Clinical Research, University of Southern Denmark (SDU), invites applications for a 3-year PhD scholarship for a highly motivated candidate interested in working at the intersection of cancer biology and endocrinology. The project aims to investigate stanniocalcin-2 (STC2) as a key mediator of adipose tissue–tumor crosstalk in obesity-related cancer.

The project is part of a larger collaborative research initiative, the Molecular Mechanisms Linking Obesity and Cancer (MMLOC) network, funded by the Novo Nordisk Foundation. Though this grant, 2/3 of the PhD salary has been secured.

Employment is therefore conditional upon the successful enrolment of the candidate as a PhD student at the PhD School at Faculty of Health Sciences, and the awarding of a one-year Faculty Scholarship. 

 

Research environment

The PhD project will be anchored at KMEB, a research unit focused on clinical and translational endocrinology, under the supervision of Associate Professor Rikke Hjortebjerg and Professor Jan Frystyk. The project will be conducted in close collaboration with the laboratory of co-supervisor Professor Henrik Ditzel, Cancer and Inflammation Research Unit, Department of Molecular Medicine, SDU. 

The candidate will work across two complementary research groups with access to state-of-the-art research facilities. Together, the groups provide a multidisciplinary research environment with close integration of clinical and experimental research. The teams are internationally oriented and offer a supportive and inclusive research culture.

You can read more about KMEB here: https://www.sdu.dk/en/forskning/kmeb

 

Project description

Our research centers around the insulin-like growth factor (IGF) system, a key hormonal regulator in several diseases. The project focuses on stanniocalcin-2 (STC2), an IGF system member that is linked to poor outcomes in most obesity-related cancers but paradoxically predicts favorable prognosis in postmenopausal estrogen receptor-positive (ER+) breast cancer. 

The aim is to examine how STC2 effects are modulated by obesity and estrogen signaling and how it regulates IGF-2/insulin receptor pathways in the tumor–adipose microenvironment. To establish clinically relevant models, the candidate will generate patient-derived xenograft (PDX) mouse models with human tumor tissue and participate in establishing patient-derived organoids and 3D co-cultures. These systems will be interrogated using genetically engineered STC2 and PAPP-A variants and analyzed with advanced sequencing, spatial, and single-cell omics.

The PhD student will:

  • Establish and analyze PDX mouse models of ER+ breast cancer.

  • Sample and process tumor and tumor-adjacent/distant adipose tissue from breast cancer patients.

  • Assess STC2 activity, IGF-2 signaling, and tumor growth under estrogen-controlled conditions.

  • Help analyze molecular data generated through sequencing and omics-based approaches.

 

Qualifications

The applicant should possess the following qualifications:

  • A master’s degree (MSc or equivalent) in molecular biology, biomedicine, or related fields. 

  • Preferably prior experience with endocrinology or cancer research. 

  • An interest in working with animal models (mice) is a necessity.

  • Excellent communication skills in English, both written and spoken.

  • A motivated, independent, and quality-oriented approach to research, with enthusiasm for learning new scientific disciplines and methodologies.

 

For further information about the project, please contact:
Rikke Hjortebjerg

KMEB, Department of Clinical Research

University of Southern Denmark (SDU)

E-mail: rhjortebjerg@health.sdu.dk


Applications must include:

• At letter stating the interest, motivation and qualifications for the project (max. 2 pages) - upload under “Application form”.
• Detailed CV, including personal contact information
• Certified copy of diploma (Master’s degree in a relevant field)


Further information about the PhD-study can be found at the homepage of the University.


Applications must be submitted electronically using the link "Apply now". Attached files must be in Adobe PDF format. We strongly recommend that you read How to apply for a position at SDU before you apply.

Incomplete applications and applications received after the deadline will neither be considered nor evaluated. This also applies to reference letters.

 

Closing date September 1, 2026

Successful candidates will be asked to send an application to the PhD Secretariat, Faculty of Health Sciences, to be enrolled as PhD students.

The PhD programme will be carried out in accordance with Faculty regulations and the Danish Ministerial Order on the PhD Programme at the Universities (PhD order)

 

Salary and Working Conditions at SDU

PhD students employed at SDU are employed as PhD fellows according to the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations in public employment (AC) agreement.


Salary and any salary supplement are paid according to your seniority level and as negotiated with your union representative. The base salary (excluding 18.07% pension contribution) is DKK 374,912.98.

The University wishes our staff to reflect the diversity of society and thus welcomes applications from all qualified candidates regardless of personal background.

title: Finance Manager
description:
Finance Manager to ICARS Would you like to be part of an international institution with highly skilled colleagues from more than 20 different countries? Would you like to join a purpose-driven institution contributing to global health and development where you will have the opportunity to shape and strengthen the support functions as we continue to grow and mature as an organisation? Then you may be our new Finance Manager.

This is a full-time position available as soon as possible.



About ICARS

ICARS is an autonomous, self-governing, non-profit organization, international in character, established by the Danish Government and overseen by the Danish Ministry of Foreign Affairs. ICARS receives funding from the Danish Government and other institutional donors and foundations and supports low- and middle-income countries in developing solutions to antimicrobial resistance (AMR). ICARS collaborates with governments, research institutions and global organisations to bridge research, policy and implementation.

With an annual budget is around 100m DKK, 50+ FTE’s, more than 70 projects across 30+ countries, a growing global footprint, and increasing organisational complexity, the Finance Team plays a crucial role in the management of all financial aspects of ICARS’ projects and running ICARS as an organization.



We offer

We offer an exciting opportunity to be part of a growing team that is developing the scientific and organisational foundation of ICARS. Our team is composed of enthusiastic international pioneers from across the globe that all believe in ICARS’ mission and are highly motivated to ensure its success.

We are based at Statens Serum Institute in Copenhagen, Denmark.

Please visit www.icars-global.org for more information.



About the position

As an experienced Finance Manager, you will have overall professional responsibility for ICARS’ financial management, budgeting, reporting, annual and project auditing to ensure that ICARS meets all accounting and reporting requirements from funders. Furthermore, you are responsible for maintaining and further developing efficient work processes and promoting the effective use of IT systems and digital tools to support operational excellence.

While the role does not have direct people management responsibilities, it is expected to provide strong professional leadership by acting as a trusted sparring partner and subject matter expert for the team. The Finance team consists of 3.5 FTEs working closely together to ensure the effective delivery of financial services across the organisation.



Your main tasks

  • Take overall professional responsibility for ICARS’ financial accounting and ensure complete, accurate and timely financial records.
  • Lead preparation of ICARS’ annual organisational budget and consolidated project portfolio budget.
  • Lead the monthly, quarterly and year-end closing processes and the liaison with the auditors.
  • Prepare forecasting, financial analysis and reporting to the management and the board.
  • Coordinate and quality-assure finance activities and provide professional guidance to other finance and operations staff.
  • Advise budget holders and project managers on financial performance, risks and required actions, and ensure quality reporting according to donor requirements.
  • Act as functional owner of ICARS’ financial systems, reporting structures and finance data, including Navision Stat, Business Central.
  • Further develop and continuously improve ICARS financial reporting system, financial management structures, digital tools and automation.


Your background, professional and personal qualifications

We expect that you hold a degree in finances, economics, accounting or equivalent. It will be considered an advantage, if you have worked in an institution administrating funds from multiple donors, including the Danish government.

Professional qualifications

  • At least 3 years of proven success in a similar role.
  • Relevant professional experience in leading financial accounting, financial management and audit, including independent responsibility for financial closing, reporting or audit processes.
  • Understanding of Danish public-sector financial management, preferably gained in a Danish state institution, a self-governing institution or an organisation working closely with Danish government authorities.
  • Assuring compliance with regulations, standards and requirements associated with budgeting, financial reporting, grants and project administration.
  • Experience with international operations, foreign currency management, and partner-managed grants is an advantage.
  • Strong practical experience with Navision Stat, NAV, Business Central and associated state systems (SDI, RejsUd etc) or similar systems. Advanced Excel skills and the ability to develop useful financial analyses and reports.
  • Experience and interest in adopting AI to increase efficiency in finance controlling environment.
Personal qualifications

  • Excellent organisational skills with demonstrated ability to successfully manage competing priorities.
  • Combine strong attention to detail and accuracy with the ability to maintain an overview of the organisation’s overall financial position.
  • Work systematically, meet demanding deadlines and plan effectively around reporting and audit cycles.
  • Can explain complex financial matters clearly to colleagues without a finance background.
  • Ability to build strong relationships and good collaboration with both internal and external stakeholders.
  • Interested in improving processes, systems and the use of data and automation in finance.
  • Proficiency in English (English is our working language). As you will be collaborating with Danish partners, experience in Danish will also be considered an advantage.


Terms of employment

This is a full-time position available as soon as possible.

Salary and appointment terms will be based on the collective agreement between the Danish Ministry of Finance and the recognised negotiating organisations, depending on the candidate’s educational background. We expect the position to be classified at the level of chief consultant (Chefkonsulent) according to the AC Collective Agreement.

For non-Danish citizens living outside Denmark, relocation is a requirement. In this case a monthly relocation supplement and a relocation package consisting of a lumpsum and administrative assistance by settling in Denmark is added to your salary.

Please note that your total income is subject to taxation according to ordinary Danish tax rules and not under special beneficial tax schemes.



Further information

For further information about the position, please contact Executive Director Helle Engslund Krarup, at +45 24852974.



Application and recruitment process

Press “apply for the position” and submit your CV and relevant diplomas along with a cover letter outlining your suitability for the role and motivation for applying no later than August 17th, 2026, at 23.59.

title: Europcar søger en FP&A Manager
description:
FP&A Manager

Vil du spille en central rolle i at styrke finansiel styring, rapportering med stort forretningsaspekt i en dynamisk biludlejningsvirksomhed med sund vækst? Til at løfte vores finansfunktion til næste niveau søger vi en analytisk stærk FP&A Manager.

Om rollen

 Som FP&A Manager har du en nøglerolle i at udvikle og styrke virksomhedens rapportering, business controlling, FP&A og BI på tværs af den danske forretning. Udover den danske forretning, vil en mindre del af de opgaver, der hører til rollen, også gå med at supportere og drive den finske budget og forecast proces.

Med reference til vores Finance Director har du og dit team ansvaret for at sikre høj kvalitet i den månedlige rapportering samt drive vores forecast- og budgetprocesser i tæt samarbejde med forretningen. Du vil derfor spille en væsentlig rolle i videreudvikling af vores eksisterende, solide fundament.

Samtidig fungerer du som et centralt bindeled til koncernens finansfunktion, hvor du sikrer rettidig, konsistent og veldokumenteret rapportering og bidrager til at skabe transparens og sammenhæng i den finansielle performance.

Dine primære ansvarsområder

  • Sikre høj kvalitet i månedlig rapportering til ledelse og koncern

  • Koordinere og kvalitetssikre rapporteringspakker til Europcar Mobility Group Finance

  • Drive og udvikle budget- og forecastprocesser i Danmark og Finland

  • Udvikle og styrke brugen af forretningsdata, herunder rapporteringsværktøjer, dashboards og datagrundlag

I dag består vores FP&A afdeling af to controllere, der hver dag arbejder målrettet og ambitiøst for at levere til forretningen. Afdelingen er et godt sted i sammenhold og kultur. Og der er ønske om, at du som leder fokuserer på at teamet går fremtiden i møde med den rette støtte og ser løft af kompetencer og udvikling som vejen derhen.

Ansvaret for teamet indebærer også, at:

  • Sikre klare prioriteringer og høj kvalitet i leverancer

  • Udvikle teamets kompetencer og arbejdsprocesser

  • Skabe et motiverende og professionelt arbejdsmiljø

Udover dit fokus på os og teamet, har vi naturligt også et fokus på dig, så dit faglige og professionelle bidrag i virksomheden stemmer overens med det, vi søger.

Derfor forestiller vi os, at du:

  • Har en relevant videregående uddannelse inden for økonomi, finans eller lignende

  • Har dokumenteret solid erfaring med FP&A, controlling eller reporting – gerne fra en større organisation eller koncern

  • Har erfaring med budget- og forecastprocesser

  • Kan demonstrere god forretningsforståelse og evner at omsætte data til indsigt

  • Trives i en rolle med både operationelle og udviklingsorienterede opgaver

  • Har ledelseserfaring eller er klar til dette næste skridt i din karriere

Hvis du kan se dig selv i rollen og synes vi lyder interessante, kan vi opsummeret tilbyde:

  • En central rolle med stor indflydelse på udvikling af afdelingen

  • Gode muligheder for faglig og personlig udvikling

  • En attraktiv markedsrelevant lønpakke. Yderligere oplyses forud for eventuel forhandling.

  • Indtræden i en finansafdeling med stærkt sammenhold og høj faglighed

  • En arbejdshverdag i en organisation, hvor der er højt til loftet og plads til mennesket.

Ansøgningsfrist d.17. august 2026. Vi behandler ansøgninger løbende og holder samtaler undervejs, da vi gerne vil finde den helt rette kandidat til stillingen. Vi opfordrer derfor interesserede til at søge hurtigst muligt.

Vi hører rigtig gerne fra dig via vores karriereportal. Men har du forinden spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte Finance Director, Thomas Lyngholm Jacobsen +45 61 99 99 87 | TLJ@europcar.dk

We welcome and encourage applications from individuals of all backgrounds, experiences, and abilities, regardless of race, ethnicity, gender reassignment, nationality, sexual orientation, age, disability status, religion, or any other dimension of diversity. We are dedicated to building a team that reflects the communities we serve and fostering an environment of equity and inclusion, where respect for one another is essential. If you need any accommodations or assistance during the application or interview process, please let us know. Together, through mutual respect, we can create a more equitable and inclusive future.
